problem.text: The README conversion-time description used the ungrammatical phrase “for a smaller models.”

reasoning.text: Removing “a” makes the phrase agree with the plural “models,” without changing the surrounding conversion claims.

impact.text: The change corrects README prose only; it does not alter executable code or the stated performance estimates.

limitations: The surrounding performance estimates were not verified. No computation or runtime test is useful for this grammatical correction.

claims.text: README.md now says conversion takes “a couple of minutes for smaller models,” preserving the existing contrast with larger models.

annotation.summary: Corrects “for a smaller models” to “for smaller models” in the README.
